title: Love the app
body: I like the app for its simplicity and no frills, does its functions well. Sometimes the languages get mixed up (Mandarin and English) so it would be nice if its fixed. Other than that I absolutely love everything

title: I love the app but it still need to improve the English language
body:
Love the UI, and the behavior.
Simple and easy to use.
Still need to improve some features, the most important is the English language translating.
I would love to this app if the the language is improve.
I have seen the upgrade, the habit statistic in one month, nice thing and good work.
Looking for the update.
